info.title: terse
info.description: Token-efficient Roslyn MCP server for C# and .NET. Navigate, read, edit and refactor a solution semantically instead of reading whole files.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the MCP server over stdio.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Solution or project to load at startup.

options.name: --read-only
options.description: Expose read tools only.

options.name: --no-watch
options.description: Do not watch the workspace for external file changes. TERSE_WATCH=0 does the same.

options.name: --max-workspaces
options.description: How many solutions stay loaded at once; the least recently used is unloaded beyond that. Default 4. TERSE_MAX_WORKSPACES does the same. A large solution costs gigabytes, so set 1 when you only ever work in one.

options.name: --idle-minutes
options.description: Drop a workspace's Roslyn compilations after it has been idle this long, and return the memory. Default 15; 0 keeps them for the life of the process. TERSE_IDLE_MINUTES does the same. The next semantic call re-realizes what it needs.

options.name: --tools
options.description: Which tools to advertise: core, a ~20-tool subset, or all, the whole surface. Unset, it advertises the families the loaded solution holds - the default - and an unrecognised value falls back to that. Every other tool still answers when called by name; only the advertised list shrinks, which is the measured lever on tool-selection accuracy. TERSE_TOOLS does the same.
